dt: White papers/pre-applications encouraged by Nov 30, 2026. Applications by Feb 1, 2027 are considered for FY2027; Electron & Scanning Probe Microscopies applications by Dec 1, 2026.
e: Single-investigator and small-group grants in the BES materials core programs not covered by the condensed-matter panels. Examples are thin-film and crystal synthesis science, physical behavior of 2D materials and heterostructures, x-ray scattering and spectroscopy, and electron and scanning probe microscopy of quantum materials. U.S. universities may apply under DE-FOA-0003665.
n: DOE BES Materials Sciences & Engineering core programs (Materials Chemistry, Synthesis & Processing, Physical Behavior of Materials, X-ray Scattering, Electron & Scanning Probe Microscopies) – FY2027 Open Call
